Dear Fellow Stockholders,
2021 was an exceptional year for Castle, and I would be remiss if I did not begin by thanking our talented employees
for their tireless dedication and commitment. Each new year brings new opportunities to improve health and guide
patient care, and we are only able to achieve our goals through our combined and collaborative efforts.
2021 HIGHLIGHTS 2021 was a year of growth across our business. We exceeded our revenue expectations and
delivered full-year 2021 revenue of $94.1 million, a 50% increase over 2020. We successfully doubled our dermatology facing commercial team and delivered more than 28,000 gene expression profi le test reports, a 55% increase over our
report volume in 2020. Our commercial team continued to build strong relationships with existing and new clinicians,
which resulted in approximately 1,900 new ordering clinicians and approximately 5,900 total ordering clinicians for our
dermatologic tests.
Continuing our theme of growth, we identifi ed and executed on two strategic opportunities that we believe complement
our existing business and allow us to impact patient care in areas of unmet clinical need. The fi rst was the acquisition of
the Myriad myPath® laboratory in May 2021, which added the myPath Melanoma test to our dermatologic portfolio, and
the second was the acquisition of Cernostics in December 2021, which represents our decision to serve patients suffering
from gastrointestinal diseases. Cernostics’ TissueCypher® Barrett’s Esophagus test represents our initial test offering in the
g astro enter ology market. We believe the spatialomics platform that underlies the TissueCypher test expands our R&D and
clinical laboratory capabilities and enables us to consider new pipeline tests utilizing this advanced technology.
As a science-based company, expanding the body of scientifi c evidence supporting the value of our tests is an operating
imperative. And in 2021, our world-class R&D team delivered on our aggressive goals, successfully generating 15 peerreviewed articles supporting the value of our commercial tests and advancing our pipeline tests, including our initiative to
develop a test to predict systemic therapy response in patients with moderate-to-severe psoriasis, atopic dermatitis and
related infl ammatory skin conditions.

R&D team delivered on our aggressive goals, successfully generating 15 peerreviewed articles supporting the value of our commercial tests and advancing our pipeline tests, including our initiative to
develop a test to predict systemic therapy response in patients with moderate-to-severe psoriasis, atopic dermatitis and
related infl ammatory skin conditions.
MISSION, VISION AND VALUESSince our inception in 2008, we have built our business around innovation,
transformation and by keeping people fi rst. While we have continued to grow and evolve as an organization, these
foundational principles have remained the guidepost for the direction of our company and the basis of our long-term
value creation. Grounded in this fi rm foundation, we relaunched our Mission, Vision and Values in 2021, which depict who
we are at our core and who we aspire to be, now and into the future.
Our Mission: Improving health through innovative tests that guide patient care
Our Vision: To transform disease management by keeping people fi rst: patients, clinicians, employees and investors
Our Values: Trust, Excellence, Collaboration, Integrity, Innovation and Excitement
LOOKING FORWARDWe believe our success in 2021 allows us to enter 2022 with momentum, a strong balance
sheet and the potential to further position the company as an industry leader. Driven by strong execution and a focus on
three key operational pillars – our strong core dermatology business, pipeline initiatives and strategic opportunities – we
anticipate continued growth and value creation in the near- and long-term.
At Castle, we believe wholeheartedly that our success is due to our steadfast commitment to keeping people fi rst:
patients, clinicians, employees and you, our valued investors. Thank you for your continued support, as we strive to truly
transform disease management in the years to come.
Sincerely,
Derek Maetzold
Founder, President & CEO
